name: bridge
title: Reconciliation bridge
description: Waterfall chart walking from the left total to the right total through reconciling item groups.
needs: A numeric measure; the left and right totals are the opening and closing points.

text.title: {left} to {right}
text.lede: Each step is a group of reconciling items that walks the total of {leftShort} to the total of {rightShort}. A step takes the colour of the side that holds the items. Select a step to see what is in it.
text.unexplainedNote: What is left after every item above. Nothing has been found for it yet.
text.noItems: No items explain this amount. It stays open until someone finds them.

options.name: showUnexplained
options.description: Include a residual unexplained step if the bridge does not fully balance.
